**Key to columns**

- **Ref No.**: Unique contract reference assigned by the Maintenance Committee.
- **Vendor / Contractor**: Registered vendor name as per the agreement.
- **Work / Service**: Brief description of the service covered.
- **Start Date**: Date on which the contract came into effect.
- **End Date**: Date on which the contract expires (inclusive).
- **Renewal / Quote Deadline**: Date and time by which a renewal quote or submission must reach the Committee office, as per the agreement or committee resolution.
